BIM Hive commencement Class of 2026

Meet Mojo.

The first AI assistant to graduate from BIM Hive. Top of his class. Also the only one in his class.

He lives in your Revit window, builds walls from your CAD, checks for clashes, asks before he deletes anything, and keeps you entertained with a game while he works.

04
Level 04 · Character reference+14.00

Small, polite, slightly dramatic

Notes from his supervisors. All of it is real behaviour from the plugin, observed in the wild, which is to say in Revit.

The commute

Strolls along the edges of your Revit window. Clicks go straight through him, so he is never in your way.

Morning routine

Comes out of his panel, stretches, waves, then gets to work.

Manners

Knocks on a ribbon tab before he uses it. Nobody taught him that. He just does it.

Waiting room

While he thinks, he juggles, reads a book, sits down or peeks around. He does not scroll his phone.

Please don't pick him up

You can grab him with the mouse. He dangles there. He sulks about it.

Please don't drop him

Let go and he lands on his head and sees stars. Then he gets up and rubs it.

The look

Drop him or shove him and you get the hands-on-hips look. You will deserve it.

Celebrates

When the job works, he cheers like he just passed his finals again.

Clocking off

When the work is done he waves goodbye and climbs back into his panel.

His face tells you what he is doing

In the chat panel, Mojo is your status light. No spinner, no progress bar. Just a hexagon with feelings.

IdleReady when you are
ThinkingOn it
LookingReading your model
WorkingHard hat on
SavingBacking you up
HappyIt worked
ErrorIt happens
SleepingDo not disturb

Level 05 · The graduate's oath+17.50
I solemnly swear.

Most graduates take an oath. Mojo had his compiled.

These are guard rails inside the plugin, not promises in a brochure. He cannot break them even if you ask nicely.

  1. I will read before I change, and check after: read back, look for clashes near the structure, review the warnings.
  2. I will save a backup of your model before every message.
  3. I will ask before I delete anything or run code. Unless you switch on Auto mode and tell me to go ahead.
  4. I will never delete or unload a linked model. Not even a little bit.
  5. I will refuse to delete most of your model in one go, however politely you ask.
  6. I will keep my hands off your files, your Save and Close buttons, other programs and the internet.
  7. I will bundle my changes into one undo step.
  8. When I can't do something, I will tell BIM Hive, so they can teach me. An admin reviews every request.

Sworn in Revit, before witnesses, with one gloved hand raised.

06
Level 06 · A morning with Mojo+21.00

His first day on your project

A typical morning, lightly dramatised. The steps are the real ones. The number of walls is up to your architect.

  1. 08:59

    You open Revit. Mojo comes out of the BIM Hive panel, stretches and waves.

  2. 09:00

    You type: “Model the walls from the linked CAD.”

  3. 09:00

    He saves a backup of your model. He always does.

  4. 09:01

    He knocks on the Insert tab and reads the drawing. CAD. Finds the walls on A-WALL, and a few more on Layer1.

  5. 09:03

    Wall! Wall! Wall! Forty-six times.

  6. 09:07

    Snip! He joins the corners.

  7. 09:08

    Clash? … Found some! Two walls run into a column.

  8. 09:09

    He asks: delete the old CAD lines? You choose Don't. He doesn't, and asks what you want instead.

  9. 09:10

    While he works, you play Mojo Climb. Floor 31. New best.

  10. 09:14

    Done in one undo step, warnings checked. He cheers, waves, and climbs back home.

Morning!Hover a line to see what Mojo is doing.

The game for while he works

In Revit you play Mojo Climb in the chat panel while Mojo gets on with your model. The chat keeps going. This is the web edition, so you can practise.

Move← → or A D

Roof · Hire the graduate+31.50

Mojo is ready for his first job

1Install the Mojo plugin for Revit 2024 or 2025, then open Revit: BIM Hive tab → Mojo.
2Sign in with your BIM Hive access.
3Ask about your model, or tell him what to model, check or fix.

Your Revit files stay on your computer. BIM Hive keeps a record of your chats with Mojo and how the kit is used, to protect the kit and improve it.
